study type: Multicenter retrospective study with external validation
outcome: Stress urinary incontinence (SUI) within one year postpartum
cohort: The study recruited 1,531 postpartum women who gave birth at two hospitals in Kunshan City between 2021 and 2022, with a final analysis population of 1,125 women.
finding: A predictive model (nomogram) for stress urinary incontinence within one year postpartum for Chinese women was successfully developed and externally validated, showing good discrimination (AUC 0.829 in training, 0.746 in validation) and potential as an effective screening tool.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a significant factor and incorporated into the nomogram for predicting stress urinary incontinence.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was included as a predictive factor in the model.
